sharedPrompt.format: One full-bleed illustration that fills the whole image edge to edge. Flat 2D illustration, no 3D rendering, no photorealism.
sharedPrompt.artStyle: Loud, funny cartoon illustration in the manner of a 1980s wrestling event poster crossed with a Saturday-morning comic: thick black ink outlines, bold flat colours, halftone dot shading, speed lines and dramatic low camera angles. Muscular, over-the-top farm animals with huge personalities, wearing wrestling masks, capes, trunks, boots and championship belts. Palette: fire-engine red, championship gold, denim blue, cream and barn-wood brown, with bright spotlight yellow highlights. Hay, mud splashes and flying feathers everywhere. Subtle paper grain like a vintage printed card. Overall mood: rowdy, triumphant, silly and full of energy.
frame: Border: a thick border styled like the edge of a wrestling ring: three taut ring ropes in red, white and denim blue running round the card, padded red turnbuckles in the four corners, and weathered red barn-wood planks with gold rivets behind the ropes. Small stars, horseshoes and wisps of hay worked in as ornament.
Top-left corner: a small round set emblem shaped like a gold championship belt buckle with a cow's head in the middle, with no letters.
Top: an empty name banner shaped like a long gold championship belt plate with studs at each end, about 10% of the card height, with no letters in it.

Bottom: a text panel below the window, about a quarter of the card height, in pale cream like an old fight poster, with a thin denim-blue edge. The upper half of the panel is empty space for two lines of text. A thin denim-blue divider line runs across the middle of the panel.

Stats row: the lower half of the panel is split into three equal cells side by side by thin vertical denim-blue dividers. Each cell has one small bold icon on its left side, no wider than a quarter of the cell, and the right three-quarters of the cell is empty space for a long word like 'SHOWMANSHIP' and a large number. The icons, left to right: a flexing muscly arm; an old-fashioned announcer's microphone; a splat of brown mud. The icons are simple, flat and bold, in red, gold, denim blue and brown.

Card number and rarity: below the panel, on the border, two separate empty badges of the same height. In the bottom-left corner, a wide dark denim-blue plaque with a gold edge for the card number, about 22% of the card width, so it can hold text like '#30 of 30'. In the bottom-right corner, a wide pill-shaped pale gold badge for the rarity, about 25% of the card width, so it can hold a word of nine capital letters. Both are empty, with no letters.
Accent colours on the frame are only red, gold, denim blue and cream. Do not use pink, magenta or hot pink anywhere on the frame.
sharedPrompt.negative: No photorealism, no 3D render, no anime style, no gore or blood, no real wrestlers or real people, no real wrestling company logos, no modern vector/flat-design look, no watermarks, no extra text, no blurry or cut-off borders, no real or existing cartoon characters.

cards.name: El Moo-cho
cards.character: A muscular black-and-white bull luchador wearing a bright red and gold wrestling mask with flames around the eye holes, a sparkly red cape, gold wrestling boots and a nose ring.
cards.poseAndExpression: Leaping off the top turnbuckle with arms spread wide, cape flying, mid-flight toward the viewer.
cards.backgroundScene: A packed barn arena at night with hay-bale bleachers full of cheering farm animals and spotlights cutting through dust.
cards.flavourText: He flies. Bulls are not supposed to fly.

cards.name: The Udder Destruction
cards.character: An enormous, heavyweight dairy cow champion with huge shoulders, a giant gold championship belt round her waist, red wrestling trunks, taped hooves and a cowbell on a chain round her neck.
cards.poseAndExpression: Standing in the centre of the ring holding the gold belt high above her head with both hooves, roaring in triumph as confetti falls.
cards.backgroundScene: A huge barn arena with fireworks, a crowd of farm animals going wild, and a giant spotlight on the ring.
cards.flavourText: Undefeated. Unmilked. Unstoppable.

cards.name: Captain Cluck
cards.character: A puffed-up little hen in a tiny blue superhero cape and red wrestling singlet, with a determined frown and a single feather sticking up on her head.
cards.poseAndExpression: Strutting along the ring apron, chest out, wings on hips, glaring at the crowd.
cards.backgroundScene: The side of a wrestling ring in a dusty barn, with a few chicks cheering from the front row.
cards.flavourText: She lays eggs and smackdowns.

cards.name: The Baa-barian
cards.character: A huge ram with massive curled horns, a fur loincloth-style pair of wrestling trunks, leather wrist bands, a horned helmet and a shaggy beard.
cards.poseAndExpression: Charging headfirst across the ring with horns lowered, wool flying off in tufts.
cards.backgroundScene: A wooden barn ring with splintered ropes, hay flying, and a fallen opponent in the corner.
cards.flavourText: He ruled the field. Then he ruled the ring.

cards.name: The Quack Pack
cards.character: A tag team of two identical chubby ducks in matching yellow and blue singlets and swimming goggles worn like wrestling masks.
cards.poseAndExpression: Both ducks leaping together off the ropes in a perfectly synchronised double flying kick.
cards.backgroundScene: A muddy farm pond turned into an outdoor wrestling ring, with lily pads and reeds round the edges.
cards.flavourText: Twice the quack. Twice the attack.

cards.name: Sir Hamsalot
cards.character: A small, round piglet in a tiny knight's helmet with a plume, a wrestling singlet and a cardboard shield, puffing out his chest.
cards.poseAndExpression: Standing on a hay bale to look taller, shaking a tiny fist at a much bigger opponent off-screen.
cards.backgroundScene: The edge of a barn ring, with a giant shadow falling across him from someone very large.
cards.flavourText: Small in size. Large in opinion.

cards.name: Nanny Knuckles
cards.character: A tough old grandma goat with grey whiskers, horn-rimmed spectacles, a knitted cardigan worn over a wrestling singlet, and boxing-tape wrapped round her hooves.
cards.poseAndExpression: Hitting an opponent with her handbag while the referee looks the other way, cackling.
cards.backgroundScene: A barn ring with knitting needles and a ball of yarn on the turnbuckle, an outraged crowd.
cards.flavourText: She was wrestling before your grandad was a kid.

cards.name: Gnasher the Rope-Eater
cards.character: A wild-eyed, scruffy billy goat with long beard and crooked horns, wearing torn denim shorts and a spiked collar, with bits of chewed ring rope hanging from his mouth.
cards.poseAndExpression: Standing in the ring chewing through the top rope while the referee and announcer panic in the background.
cards.backgroundScene: A wrecked barn arena with snapped ropes, a broken turnbuckle and hay everywhere, the crowd half cheering and half fleeing.
cards.flavourText: There are no rules. He ate the rule book.

cards.name: Turkey Trot
cards.character: A lanky, nervous turkey with a wobbly red wattle, running shoes, a sweatband and a wrestling singlet covered in lightning bolts.
cards.poseAndExpression: Sprinting round the ring at full speed with feathers flying and a cartoon dust cloud behind him.
cards.backgroundScene: A barn ring with motion lines everywhere and a dizzy opponent spinning in the centre.
cards.flavourText: He cannot win, but he cannot be caught.

cards.name: Mudslide Malone
cards.character: A big, happy pink pig wrestler absolutely caked in mud, wearing brown trunks, a backwards baseball cap and a gold tooth.
cards.poseAndExpression: Belly-flopping into a pool of mud in the centre of the ring, sending a huge splash toward the viewer.
cards.backgroundScene: An outdoor mud-pit ring in the farmyard with mud-splattered fans in raincoats in the front row.
cards.flavourText: Front row tickets come with a free shower.

cards.name: The Masked Mallard
cards.character: A mysterious, sleek drake mallard in a black and gold full-face wrestling mask, a long black cape and a cool, silent stare.
cards.poseAndExpression: Standing on the top rope with wings folded inside his cape, one eyebrow raised, under a single spotlight.
cards.backgroundScene: A darkened barn arena with smoke on the floor and a single beam of light on the ring.
cards.flavourText: Nobody knows who he is. Everyone knows what he does.

cards.name: Big Bad Boar
cards.character: A huge, bristly wild boar with tusks, a mohawk of stiff hair, studded leather vest, chains and black wrestling boots, the meanest heel in the barn.
cards.poseAndExpression: Snarling and pointing at the crowd while they boo, one hoof on a fallen opponent.
cards.backgroundScene: A barn ring under red spotlights with fans throwing popcorn and corn cobs at him.
cards.flavourText: Boo him all you like. He loves it.

cards.name: Woolly Bully
cards.character: A small, extremely fluffy sheep so round with wool she looks like a cloud, wearing tiny red boots and a headband.
cards.poseAndExpression: Bouncing off the ropes like a ball, with a goofy grin.
cards.backgroundScene: A barn ring with cushion-like wool tufts floating in the air.
cards.flavourText: Opponents bounce right off.

cards.name: Haymaker Hank
cards.character: A big, slow, strong grey donkey with a lopsided grin, wearing denim overalls cut into a wrestling singlet and enormous boxing gloves.
cards.poseAndExpression: Winding up a huge overhead punch with one gloved hoof, tongue sticking out in concentration.
cards.backgroundScene: A barn ring with a stack of hay bales collapsing behind him from a missed punch.
cards.flavourText: He takes his time. He only needs one.

cards.name: Scrambled Chick
cards.character: A tiny fluffy yellow chick still wearing half an eggshell on its head like a helmet, with a tiny wrestling belt made of a bottle cap.
cards.poseAndExpression: Standing in fighting stance with tiny wings raised like fists, very serious.
cards.backgroundScene: The middle of a huge empty ring, the chick very small in the frame, a spotlight on it.
cards.flavourText: Fresh out of the shell and ready to rumble.

cards.name: Horse Power
cards.character: A powerful, gleaming chestnut stallion with a flowing blond mane, a sequinned red and gold robe, gold boots and a championship hairstyle.
cards.poseAndExpression: Flexing on the top rope with mane blowing in a wind machine, smiling for the cameras.
cards.backgroundScene: A grand barn arena with camera flashes everywhere and a red carpet entrance ramp.
cards.flavourText: Two hundred horsepower. All of it hair.

cards.name: Referee Hoot
cards.character: A wise, serious barn owl in a black and white striped referee shirt with a whistle round its neck and huge round eyes.
cards.poseAndExpression: Turning its head completely round to watch two wrestlers at once, holding up a hand to count.
cards.backgroundScene: The middle of a barn ring with two blurry wrestlers grappling on either side.
cards.flavourText: It sees everything. It still misses the handbag.

cards.name: Sheepdog Steve
cards.character: A scruffy black and white sheepdog manager in a loud checked suit, sunglasses and a gold chain, holding a clipboard and a megaphone.
cards.poseAndExpression: Shouting through the megaphone at the ring from the corner, waving the clipboard.
cards.backgroundScene: Ringside of a barn arena with a crowd of sheep in the bleachers behind him.
cards.flavourText: He has rounded up a fight.

cards.name: Crowin' Kevin
cards.character: A tall, proud rooster ring announcer in a shiny tuxedo jacket and bow tie, holding an old-fashioned microphone that dangles from the ceiling.
cards.poseAndExpression: Leaning back with the microphone, beak wide open, giving a long dramatic announcement.
cards.backgroundScene: The centre of the ring under bright spotlights, the crowd blurred and cheering behind.
cards.flavourText: Let's get ready to... cock-a-doodle-doo!

cards.name: Big Bertha the Barn-Crusher
cards.character: A colossal, mountain-sized sow in a red and gold leotard, wristbands and a tiara, with a confident grin and arms as thick as tree trunks.
cards.poseAndExpression: Body-slamming an opponent so hard the whole ring bounces and the barn roof shakes loose straw.
cards.backgroundScene: A barn arena seen from a low angle, beams cracking, the crowd lifted out of their seats by the shockwave.
cards.flavourText: The barn had to be rebuilt. Twice.

cards.name: Lady Llama
cards.character: A haughty, elegant llama with a glamorous fringe, long eyelashes, a feather boa, sparkly wrestling suit and an expression of total disdain.
cards.poseAndExpression: Spitting a huge gob at her opponent with perfect aim while posing for the crowd.
cards.backgroundScene: A barn ring with a disgusted opponent wiping their face, cameras flashing.
cards.flavourText: Never, ever, insult the fringe.

cards.name: The Grain Grabber
cards.character: A tiny, cheeky barn mouse with a bandit's mask, a sack of grain over its shoulder and a little wrestling singlet.
cards.poseAndExpression: Running off with the championship belt, which is much bigger than he is, dragging it across the floor.
cards.backgroundScene: Under the ring apron in a barn, with startled wrestlers peering down.
cards.flavourText: Nobody saw him take it. Everybody saw him drop it.

cards.name: The Feathered Fury
cards.character: A lean, fierce fighting rooster high-flyer with a bright red comb, iridescent tail feathers, a red bandana and taped feet.
cards.poseAndExpression: Spinning through the air in a corkscrew dive off the top of a stack of hay bales.
cards.backgroundScene: An outdoor farmyard ring at sunrise, with the sun rising behind him and the crowd looking up.
cards.flavourText: Every morning he wakes the farm. Every evening he puts it to sleep.

cards.name: Bucket Head Bob
cards.character: A clumsy, friendly young calf with a metal milk bucket stuck on his head, little wrestling trunks and big wobbly legs.
cards.poseAndExpression: Stumbling across the ring with arms out, accidentally knocking over an opponent.
cards.backgroundScene: A barn ring with a surprised opponent tumbling over the ropes.
cards.flavourText: He has never seen an opponent. He has beaten several.

cards.name: The Ewe-nited Twins
cards.character: A tag team of two matching lambs in sparkly gold capes and identical red masks, holding hooves and grinning.
cards.poseAndExpression: Both lambs leaping together off the ropes in a perfectly mirrored double dropkick.
cards.backgroundScene: A barn ring with a giant flag of a sheep's face hanging over it and fans waving foam hooves.
cards.flavourText: Two lambs. One mind. No mercy.

cards.name: Tumbleweed
cards.character: A small, spiky hedgehog in a tiny wrestling mask, who curls into a ball to attack.
cards.poseAndExpression: Rolling across the ring at high speed in a ball, leaving a trail of dust and spikes.
cards.backgroundScene: A barn ring with a hopping opponent holding a sore foot.
cards.flavourText: Do not try to pin him. Really, do not.

cards.name: Grumpy Gertie
cards.character: A cross white goose with a furious frown, a red bandana and wrestling boots, wings spread wide, hissing.
cards.poseAndExpression: Chasing a much bigger wrestler out of the ring, neck stretched out, honking.
cards.backgroundScene: The barn arena aisle, with fans diving out of the way.
cards.flavourText: The scariest animal on the farm, and everybody knows it.

cards.name: The Shire Giant
cards.character: An enormous, gentle shire horse with feathery white hooves, a braided mane, a flat cap and a wrestling singlet, smiling kindly.
cards.poseAndExpression: Lifting two opponents above his head, one in each hoof, looking calm and polite about it.
cards.backgroundScene: A huge barn ring that looks small around him, the crowd gasping.
cards.flavourText: He says sorry after every match. He means it.

cards.name: The Barnstormer
cards.character: A towering, shaggy highland cow champion with enormous wide horns tied with gold ribbons, a flowing ginger fringe, a tartan cape and a giant gold belt.
cards.poseAndExpression: Bursting through the barn doors on her entrance with pyrotechnics exploding behind her and horns lowered.
cards.backgroundScene: A barn arena exploding with fireworks, smoke and confetti, the crowd on its feet.
cards.flavourText: When the barn doors blow open, the match is already over.

cards.name: Rabbit Punch
cards.character: A small, fast, wiry rabbit boxer with long ears taped up, tiny red gloves and a mouthguard.
cards.poseAndExpression: Bouncing on his toes and throwing a blur of tiny punches at a much bigger opponent's knee.
cards.backgroundScene: A barn ring with a huge bull opponent looking down, confused.
cards.flavourText: He is fast. He is tiny. He is mostly ignored.

cards.name: El Chivo Loco
cards.character: A wiry, wild-eyed white goat luchador with curved horns poking out through holes in a bright green, gold and red lucha libre mask decorated with lightning bolts, a matching cape, gold wrestling boots and a little goatee sticking out of the mask.
cards.poseAndExpression: Springing off the top rope in a spinning flying headbutt, horns first, cape fluttering behind him.
cards.backgroundScene: A packed barn arena decorated with colourful paper flags and piñatas, a crowd of farm animals in sombreros cheering.
cards.flavourText: Nobody knows what is under the mask. Probably more goat.

cards.name: Frog Splash Fred
cards.character: A plump, cheerful green pond frog in tiny red trunks and a sweatband, with huge springy back legs.
cards.poseAndExpression: Leaping from the top turnbuckle in a flat belly-first splash, arms and legs spread wide.
cards.backgroundScene: A barn ring next to the duck pond, lily pads floating in a paddling pool at ringside.
cards.flavourText: He has one move. It is a very good move.

cards.name: Doctor Quackenstein
cards.character: A scheming duck mad scientist in a stained white lab coat over a black wrestling singlet, round goggles, wild white head feathers and a clipboard of evil plans.
cards.poseAndExpression: Rubbing his wings together with a cackle at ringside, while a bubbling flask of green potion sits on the apron.
cards.backgroundScene: A barn ring with a crackling homemade science machine in the corner, sparks flying from the wires.
cards.flavourText: He has a plan. It involves a lot of duct tape.

cards.name: Pony Express
cards.character: A small, speedy Shetland pony with a huge shaggy fringe over her eyes, a mail bag satchel, and lightning-bolt wrestling boots.
cards.poseAndExpression: Galloping around the ring so fast her hooves are a blur, fringe streaming back.
cards.backgroundScene: A barn ring with dust trails and dizzy opponents on the canvas.
cards.flavourText: Delivers on time. Delivers a beating.

cards.name: The Alpaca-lypse
cards.character: A towering, fluffy cream alpaca with an enormous pompadour of wool, a black leather jacket over a wrestling singlet, and a bored, unbothered expression.
cards.poseAndExpression: Standing completely still while an opponent bounces off his fluffy chest, chewing slowly.
cards.backgroundScene: A barn arena under red and blue spotlights, the crowd laughing.
cards.flavourText: He does not move. He does not need to.

cards.name: Mole Mauler
cards.character: A stocky little mole in a miner's helmet with a lamp, tiny wrestling trunks and huge digging claws.
cards.poseAndExpression: Bursting up through a hole in the ring canvas underneath his surprised opponent.
cards.backgroundScene: A barn ring with a mole hill in the middle of the canvas and splinters flying.
cards.flavourText: He never enters the ring. He enters from below.

cards.name: Sergeant Snout
cards.character: A barrel-chested pig drill sergeant in a green army cap, dog tags, camouflage wrestling trunks and a whistle.
cards.poseAndExpression: Shouting nose to nose at a terrified opponent, finger jabbing, spit flying.
cards.backgroundScene: An outdoor farmyard ring by the pigsty, with a row of piglets doing push-ups in the background.
cards.flavourText: Drop and give him twenty. Pins.

cards.name: Slow Mo
cards.character: An ancient, calm tortoise in a tiny wrestling singlet and a sweatband on his head, wearing sunglasses.
cards.poseAndExpression: Crawling extremely slowly toward an opponent who has fallen asleep waiting.
cards.backgroundScene: A barn ring with a giant clock on the wall and cobwebs on the ropes.
cards.flavourText: He has never lost. His matches have not finished yet.

cards.name: Bantam Bruiser
cards.character: A tiny, scrappy bantam rooster with a battered comb, an eyepatch, taped wings and a toothpick in his beak.
cards.poseAndExpression: Squaring up to a giant bull, chest out, wings raised as fists.
cards.backgroundScene: Ringside in a barn, with the bull's huge legs filling most of the frame.
cards.flavourText: Pound for pound, the toughest bird alive.

cards.name: The Phantom of the Hayloft
cards.character: A mysterious, sleek black barn cat wrestler in a white half-mask, a long black and red cape and gleaming green eyes, moving like a shadow.
cards.poseAndExpression: Dropping silently from the dark hayloft rafters onto the ring, cape spread like wings, under one spotlight.
cards.backgroundScene: A dark barn arena with hay drifting down from the rafters, the crowd frozen in surprise, a single beam of light.
cards.flavourText: Nine lives. Nine titles. No losses.
